listing.name: Luddic Path Retrofitting
listing.summary: Bring an ordinary ship to Path 'shipwrights' and have it rebuilt into a more sacred design.
listing.aiSummary: Lets you convert vanilla ships into Luddic Path variants at Path markets.

description:
Bring an ordinary ship to Path 'shipwrights' and have it rebuilt into a more sacred design.

"Strip the comforts. Brace the mountings. The bones will serve."

Download 0.4.0

Features

Eight vanilla conversion routes, expanding to 36 with all supported roster packs.
Donor markers identify suitable hulls. The target menu shows only designs with donors in your active fleet.
Immediate batch conversions with brief shipwright dialogue.
Removable weapons and fighter LPCs return to cargo. Story point hullmods are removed for bonus XP, without refunding story points.
D-mods, names, captains, flagship assignment, mothball status, and CR carry over.

Visit a Path market's bar with Favorable (+10) Path relations and Neutral Church relations. Donate 25 supplies, 4 heavy armaments, or 10,000 credits per hull. At Friendly (+50) Path relations, the work is free.

Optional rosters
Luddic Enhancement, Luddic Enhancement IED, Ship/Weapon Pack, Hazard Mining Incorporated, Xxarra's Variety Pack, Knights of Ludd, JaydeePiracy, and Everybody loves KoC.

IED tankers retain their Martyr systems and cannot be recovered if destroyed.

Also handles Nexerelin and uses RetroLib's Starship Legends reputation transfer.

Dependencies
Starsector 0.98a, RetroLib 1.1.1, LazyLib, and MagicLib.

Credits
This work relies on SafariJohn's RetroLib and is highly derivative of Roider Union. Roider Union itself is optional (but highly recommended!).

Changelog
0.4.0 - Expanded variant handling (Hegemony, XIV, Lion's Guard, etc). Feedback is welcome if anything significant seems missing. Pirate variants still intentionally unsuitable. Rolled back excessive in-game mechanics description.
